recommendation: the 14z-174 close: the M19 release, the eight reds and what the close record claims about them

CLAIMED: the 14z-174 close record is accurate. M19 is released — seven assets on freeze/merged-m19, each downloaded back from GitHub and compared file-by-file against the tree, merged-m18's seven pruned — on the strength of an emulator tier at release scope reading PASS 281, FAIL 0, TIMEOUT 0 with one maintainer-approved SKIP and controls fired 92/declared 92, plus a release-cadence static tier reading PASS 169, SKIP 0, FAIL 0 with controls 201/201. The MiSTer lane was NOT re-run in that tier: its green from the earlier full run is carried forward because tools/audit_lane_carry.py shows every subject it depends on (the core, the MiSTer tooling, the romset, its nine gate scripts) byte-unchanged since the commit that run measured. The eight reds that halted the first release attempt were five gates broken by a deleted constant (fixed, and the replacement asserted byte-identical to what it replaced), three expectations stale behind rigs that moved at 14z-171/172 (attributed with one variable and re-frozen on the maintainer's ruling), and one control killed by a timeout set from a quiet measurement; none was a defect in the shipped romset, which is byte-unmoved since the M19 freeze.

decision: NOT TESTED: the MiSTer lane was not re-measured on the released tree and its green is inherited via a path-diff argument, not a run; the released assets were verified as bytes against the tree but no emulator was run against a DOWNLOADED asset; the one SKIP (audit_mask_window_ff42a2) asserts nothing and was approved rather than fixed; the re-frozen rows are attributed as to CAUSE but no claim is made that each new value is what the engine should produce; the killshread_es stock column is known to read the rig's own poke back and was re-frozen in that state by ruling; Windows and Linux were not exercised at all this sitting; and the maintainer's own confirmation that the romset plays ("I tested on MiSTer, M19 is clean and the rom made with the local webapp is good") is a report, not a measurement this session took.
